messages:
zoe_docs: Starting a compact migration doc for v1 -> v2 (API + SDK + embed swap). Looking for owners for: short JS/Py snippets, a banner copy, embed reindex example, and a QA smoke checklist.

matt_sdk: I can do JS & Python snippets and the SDK blurb. Will use `model_id` in examples and show one quick old->new line.

harper_prod: Hosted flip scheduled for 2024-11-20 18:00 UTC. Dedicated customers get a two-week opt-in. Docs must include dates, opt-in steps, and the fact we do NOT auto-translate streaming requests.

nolan_infra: Confirming infra will not silently rewrite streaming semantics. We'll ship a tiny compat helper for basic sync calls; its not production-grade. I'll add a 3-line snippet and a clear WARN.

sara_qa: QA will run smoke: generation, streaming, embeddings, and reindex run against pgvector. Tag me on PR. I'll paste a minimal reindex example for the doc.

zoe_docs: Outline: 1) deprecation banner (soft + firm copy), 2) quick migration (old vs new snippets), 3) streaming differences + checklist, 4) embed vector compatibility + reindex example, 5) FAQ and changelog links.

matt_sdk: Draft changelog line: "SDK breaking: `model` renamed to `model_id`. Streaming validation tightened; update streaming clients." Example I'll include:
```js
// v1
client.generate({ model: 'redwood/v1-small', prompt: 'hi' })
// v2
client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood/v2-efficiency', prompt: 'hi' })
```

nolan_infra: Compat helper (py):
```py
# minimal translator (sync only)
if 'model' in req:
    req['model_id'] = req.pop('model')
# WARNING: streaming frames and advanced options are NOT handled
```

sara_qa: Reindex pseudo-command for embed section: `python tools/reindex_vectors.py --src old_index --dst v2_index --model redwood/v2-embed-xl` and note to ALTER pgvector column dims before ingest if necessary.

harper_prod: FAQ bullets: API keys remain valid; latency may change (link to model catalog); Dedicated opt-in via console + support.

zoe_docs: Banner suggestions (soft): "Notice: v1 endpoints are scheduled for deprecation. See migration guide." (firm): "Deprecated: v1 endpoints retire on 2025-02-01. Migrate to v2." Use soft on reference pages.

matt_sdk: I'll open the SDK PR with snippets and blurb (due EOD tomorrow).

nolan_infra: We'll run a docs canary and smoke tests when the branch lands.

ci-bot: CI scheduled: branch `docs/migrate/v1-to-v2-lite` will run lint + smoke tests at 2024-11-08T09:00:00Z.

sara_qa: I'll run the smoke suite after PR lands and post the results as a comment.

zoe_docs: Owners & deadlines: matt_sdk (snippets + changelog, EOD tomorrow), nolan_infra (compat snippet + infra note, Mon), sara_qa (smoke plan + reindex snippet, Mon), zoe_docs (assemble guide + banners, Tue AM). I'll ping #docs-review when PR is up. :rocket:
